launch_evidence.quote: Blenrep for the treatment of patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma was approved and launched in the US and Europe in Q3 2020 and reported sales of £8 million.

search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1131399 (GSK plc) from data.sec.gov/submissions including the older 'files' pages. Results announcements selected as 6-Ks filed from 2020-07 with total size > 1 MB on the results dates (2020-07-29 ... 2026-10-28; from 2025 GSK furnishes > 1 MB buy-back 6-Ks daily, so results filings were picked by filing date and confirmed by content: each picked document prints the 'Total / US / Europe / International' turnover tables).

Product rows taken from the turnover-by-product tables whose header reads 'Total US Europe International' (columns £m, AER%, CER% per region; '£m' printed in the table's own header rows). Each table's caption ('Pharmaceuticals turnover – three months ended 30 September 2020', 'Specialty Medicines turnover – six months ended 30 June 2022', ...) decides quarter vs year-to-date; only 'three months ended' tables are used for quarters. A printed dash in the Total column is a nil (0). Quarters were summed against the six-month, nine-month and full-year tables of the same releases.

Blenrep was withdrawn from the US market in November 2022 and re-approved in 2025; GSK kept printing the line throughout, with a dash (nil) in 2024Q1, 2025Q1 and 2025Q3 and a negative (2) in 2024Q2 (returns), recorded as printed so the series stays contiguous.

Sum checks: 2020 9M: 0+0+8=8 vs printed 8 OK; 2020 FY: 0+0+8+25=33 vs printed 33 OK; 2021 H1: 21+21=42 vs printed 42 OK; 2021 9M: 21+21+25=67 vs printed 67 OK; 2021 FY: 21+21+25+22=89 vs printed 89 OK; 2022 H1: 25+30=55 vs printed 55 OK; 2022 9M: 25+30+36=91 vs printed 91 OK; 2022 FY: 25+30+36+27=118 vs printed 118 OK; 2023 H1: 11+9=20 vs printed 20 OK; 2023 9M: 11+9+10=30 vs printed 30 OK; 2023 FY: 11+9+10+6=36 vs printed 36 OK; 2024 H1: 0+-2=-2 vs printed -2 OK; 2024 9M: 0+-2+3=1 vs printed 1 OK; 2024 FY: 0+-2+3+1=2 vs printed 2 OK; 2025 H1: 0+4=4 vs printed 4 OK; 2025 9M: 0+4+0=4 vs printed 4 OK; 2025 FY: 0+4+0+13=17 vs printed 17 OK; 2026 H1: 23+36=59 vs printed 59 OK
